depends_on.name: software_id
depends_on.documentation: The implementation that applies this rule (the v1 filenavigator class name became an edge, not a string field).

fields.name: file_pattern
fields.documentation: Which files comprise ONE epoch, as declared patterns. SYNTAX: whatever the class behind `software_id` applies (Jess Haley 2026-10-22 [audit mechanical fixes 2]); for ndi.file.navigator, a regular expression in which `#` stands for the epoch's common stem, so vhlab's literal names and regexes ('reference.txt', '.*\.rhd\>') and the Haley import's '.*_1\.mp4\>' are all of it. PARSED, never eval'd: the v1 form was a string handed to eval.

fields.name: epoch_map_pattern
fields.documentation: Which of the epoch's files is the probe-map file ({'(.*)epochprobemap.ndi'}). Same parsed-not-eval'd rule.

fields.name: epoch_map_format
fields.documentation: How to parse the probe-map file ('ndi.epoch.epochprobemap_daqsystem').
